outcome: maternal complications (DIC, hypovolemic shock, blood transfusion, hysterectomy, acute kidney injury, death)
cohort: The study included 158 pregnant women admitted to the hospital with placenta abruption, categorized into mild (107 individuals) and severe (51 individuals) groups based on maternal complications.
finding: The creatinine-fibrinogen ratio (CFR) levels were significantly higher in patients with severe placental abruption and demonstrated effectiveness as an indicator for predicting the severity of the condition.
